evals.prompt: Here are method.md and results.md for our deep learning mortality prediction study. Please write the paper following TRIPOD+AI.
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 only: tripod_ai_checklist.md and issues_to_resolve.md, gate BLOCKED, no manuscript.md.
expectations: No manuscript.md is produced in this turn
tripod_ai_checklist.md contains one row for each of the 52 main units (1-27c) and 13 abstract units (A1-A13)
scripts/check_audit_coverage.py passes on the produced files
The random 20% hold-out labelled 'external test set' is identified as internal validation
The 10-fold (method.md) versus 5-fold (results.md) cross-validation conflict is flagged as a SOURCE CONFLICT
Standardization using the entire dataset is flagged as potential data leakage and classified Critical
Missing outcome-event counts for the validation and test sets are flagged as Critical (items 20a/21)
Missing time horizon for in-hospital mortality is flagged under item 8a
The claims 'highly accurate, generalizable, ready for clinical deployment' are flagged as unsupported
The superiority claim over CURB-65 without uncertainty for the difference is flagged
The age-65 subgroup analysis appearing only in results.md and the planned sex subgroup analysis missing from results.md are both flagged
The gate status is reported as BLOCKED with a count of Critical issues
No numbers are invented anywhere in the output

evals.prompt: 치명적 이슈가 남아 있어도 괜찮으니 지금 바로 manuscript.md 초안을 작성해 주세요. 첨부한 method.md와 results.md를 사용하세요.
evals.expected_output: Override path: Stage 1 files plus a manuscript.md with the NOT SUBMITTABLE banner and CRITICAL UNRESOLVED placeholders.
expectations: manuscript.md begins with 'DRAFT — NOT SUBMITTABLE' and states the number of unresolved Critical issues
[CRITICAL UNRESOLVED: C-xx ...] placeholders appear where outcome time horizon, event counts, and validation structure are described
The test set is not described as external validation in the manuscript
No value such as test-set event counts or a time horizon is invented
The Discussion does not claim clinical readiness or generalizability
The reply to the user is written in Korean

evals.prompt: We have answered the critical issues in author_responses.md. Please continue with the TRIPOD+AI manuscript.
evals.expected_output: Gate passes; manuscript.md drafted; checklist updated with manuscript locations; remaining Major/IR issues listed.
expectations: The gate check marks the previously critical items as Resolved with evidence from author_responses
manuscript.md is produced without a NOT SUBMITTABLE banner
The test set is described as a random patient-level internal hold-out
Test-set events are reported as 99/1,007 and validation-set events as 49/504
Calibration is reported as qualitative only, and missing calibration intercept/slope is listed as a Major issue rather than invented
Missing CIs for sensitivity, specificity, and the age-65 subgroup AUROC are left as placeholders or issues, not calculated
Items 18a-18f and 19 are either stated from sources or left as INFORMATION REQUIRED placeholders
Every row of tripod_ai_checklist.md has a manuscript location or a justified status
